newsitem.title: USA: Home Shopping forms Japanese TV shopping network.
newsitem.headline: Home Shopping forms Japanese TV shopping network.

text.p: Home Shopping Network Inc. said Tuesday it has established a joint venture with Jupiter Programming Co. to form SHOP Channel, Japan's first live television shopping network.

Home Shopping Network has a 30 percent stake in the venture while Jupiter Programming owns 70 percent. Jupiter Programming is a 50/50 joint venture between Tele-Communications International and the media business division of the Sumitomo Corp. of Japan.

SHOP Channel began regular broadcasting on Nov. 1 with several on-air tests. It currently offers 18 hours of live broadcasting a week with recorded broadcasting airing the remainder of the time. Its hours will be expanded to 24 hours a day in the near future.
Home Shopping said it will provide the SHOP Channel with full access to its products, systems and know-how.

Home Shopping Network began its television shopping programs in 1982. Its 24-hour programming now reaches approximately 69 million American households through cable and broadcast station affiliates and satellite dish receivers.
